scope: current host-sourced direct-effect and before/after presentation boundary without inferred causal graphs

source_contract.consequence_inference_limit: gui/consequence-links.mjs: Direct host-committed effect; no future outcome is inferred.
source_contract.causal_graph_limit: docs/history/initiatives/visual-audio/visual-audio-phase4-resolution-causal-v0.12.20.md: The client may compare before/after values to label a change.

attribution_contract.typed_effect: Committed ResolutionEffect source, metric, delta, and text fields are host-supplied direct-effect evidence.
attribution_contract.resolution_sequence: The host orders decision-time snapshots, visible responses, process/operating/resource changes, direct effects, new information, and pending processes without changing the transition.
attribution_contract.debrief: The debrief presents attributed mechanisms to inspect and preserves effect source/metric/delta text as descriptive review material.
attribution_contract.browser: The browser renders direct effects and consequence links with source and state-hash context; it does not author effects or infer a causal graph.
attribution_contract.written_fallback: Effect text, source labels, before/after values, hashes, and consequence descriptions remain available without audio or decorative motion.

presentation_surface.host_authority: Host/core resolution and debrief functions own effect source, metric, delta, text, and ordering; presentation remains read-only.
presentation_surface.shared_rendering: Shared resolution/consequence renderers display supplied direct-effect evidence and source labels without calculating new outcomes.
presentation_surface.browser_boundary: The live GUI exposes shared campaign-coverage; current direct attribution is a source-linked descriptive layer, not a full causal model.

limits: This record documents current direct-effect attribution only; it does not establish causal certainty, a causal graph, a calibrated forecast, or policy validity.
Before/after comparisons and source labels are descriptive host evidence, not hidden-input disclosure, private-rationale disclosure, or future-outcome inference.

No causal inference engine, hidden-state field, probability, counterfactual, distributional view, export format, persistence, screenshot, asset, audio file, route, or authority path is created or promoted.
No human comprehension, classroom effectiveness, accessibility, legal, educational, or public-release claim is made.
